name: io.github.nhadaututtheky/neural-memory
summary: Persistent memory for AI agents — 55 MCP tools, spreading activation recall.

name: Memory Audit
summary: Comprehensive memory quality review across 6 dimensions: purity, freshness, coverage, clarity, relevance, and structure. Generates prioritized findings with specific memory references and actionable recommendations.

name: Memory Evolution
summary: Evidence-based memory optimization from real usage patterns. Analyzes recall performance, identifies bottlenecks, suggests consolidation/pruning/enrichment, and tracks improvement over time via checkpoint Q&A.

name: Memory Intake
summary: Structured memory creation workflow. Converts messy notes, conversations, and unstructured thoughts into well-typed, tagged, confidence-scored memories. Uses 1-question-at-a-time clarification to avoid cognitive overload.
